title: been to / gone to / been in

examples.en: I have been to Beijing twice.
— Where is Tom? — He has gone to the library.
examples.zh: — 汤姆在哪？— 他去图书馆了。

guess.question: 两句都在说“去”，为什么一句用 been，一句用 gone？

options.text: 第一句人已经回来了（说经历），第二句人还没回来（人在那儿）
options.feedback: 对！been 表示“去过、已回”，gone 表示“去了、还没回”。
不对——距离远近跟 been/gone 无关。
不对——两者在书面和口语里都这么用，区别在“人回没回来”。

left.label: have been to
left.formula: have / has been to + 地点

anchor.en: I have been to Beijing twice.

left.focus: 去过（人已回来），强调经历；常与 ever / never / twice / three times 连用

right.label: have gone to
right.formula: have / has gone to + 地点

anchor.en: He has gone to the library.
anchor.zh: 他去图书馆了（还没回来）。

right.focus: 去了（人不在说话现场），常用来回答 Where is…?

contrast.diff: 人在现场、讲经历次数 → been to；人不在现场、讲去了哪儿 → gone to；要说“在那儿待了多久” → been in + 时间段（My uncle has been in Beijing for ten years）。

traps.wrong: He has gone to Beijing twice.
traps.right: He has been to Beijing twice.
traps.why: 讲“去过几次”是经历，人已回来，用 been to。

traps.wrong: — Where is Tom? — He has been to the library.
traps.right: — Where is Tom? — He has gone to the library.
traps.why: 问“人在哪儿”说明他还没回来，用 gone to。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——一句话：人在眼前用 been，人不在用 gone，待了多久用 been in。

check.stem: — Where is your father? — He ____ Shanghai on business.

options.distractor: been to 表示已经回来了，与“人在哪儿”矛盾
been in 要接时间段，如 for a week
回答“他现在在哪儿”要用完成时说明去向

check.explanation: 问“爸爸在哪儿”说明人还没回，用 has gone to。

check.stem: I ____ Beijing three times. It's a beautiful city.

options.distractor: gone to 表示人还没回来，与“讲经历”矛盾
三次是次数，不是“待了多久”
“去过三次”是到现在为止的经历，用完成时

check.explanation: 讲去过的次数，用 have been to。

options.text: She has gone to Paris twice.
She has been to Paris twice.
She has been in Paris twice.
options.distractor: been in 后面接时间段

options.text: She has go to Paris twice.
options.distractor: has 后面要接过去分词

check.explanation: “去过两次”是经历，用 has been to。
